description: Extract shared layout components (sidebar, header, footer, head) into reusable includes, then refactor all 7 admin pages to use them. This addresses items 7-10 of the requirements: shared head.php, sidebar.php, header.php, footer.php in admin/includes/. The sidebar must include ALL navigation links (Dashboard, Alumnos, Tutores, Asistencias, Usuarios, Dispositivos, Avisos) uniformly across all pages.
steps: Create admin/includes/head.php - Extract the common <head> content shared by all admin pages: meta charset, viewport, robots, TailwindCSS CDN script, Google Fonts links, and the <style> block with font-serif-elegant, font-sans-clean, bg-crema, text-vino, bg-vino, border-vino, text-dorado, bg-dorado classes. The file should accept a $page_title variable for the <title> tag.

Create admin/includes/sidebar.php - Extract the full sidebar <aside> element. It must include ALL 7 nav links: Dashboard (index.php), Alumnos (alumnos.php), Tutores (tutores.php), Asistencias (asistencias.php), Usuarios (usuarios.php), Dispositivos (dispositivos.php), Avisos (avisos.php). Use $pagina_actual variable to highlight the active page (bg-white/10 text-white for active, text-white/70 hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white for inactive). Include the user info section at the bottom.

Create admin/includes/header.php - Extract the sticky <header> bar with the mobile toggle button, page title (accept $page_header variable), username display, and logout link. Also include the mobile overlay div and the sidebar-overlay element.
Create admin/includes/footer.php - Extract the closing </main>, the toggleSidebar() <script>, and closing </body></html> tags.

Refactor admin/index.php to use: require head.php (with $page_title='Dashboard - Panel Admin SGA COBAEV'), require sidebar.php, require header.php (with $page_header='Dashboard'), and require footer.php. Remove all duplicated HTML.
Refactor admin/alumnos.php the same way (title: 'Alumnos - Panel Admin SGA COBAEV', header: 'Gestion de Alumnos').
Refactor admin/tutores.php the same way (title: 'Tutores - Panel Admin SGA COBAEV', header: 'Gestion de Tutores').
Refactor admin/asistencias.php the same way (title: 'Asistencias - Panel Admin SGA COBAEV', header: 'Historial de Asistencias').
Refactor admin/usuarios.php the same way (title: 'Usuarios - Panel Admin SGA COBAEV', header: 'Usuarios del Sistema').
Refactor admin/dispositivos.php the same way (title: 'Dispositivos - Panel Admin SGA COBAEV', header: 'Dispositivos Registrados').
Refactor admin/avisos.php the same way (title: 'Avisos - Panel Admin SGA COBAEV', header: 'Avisos a Padres').
acceptance_criteria: admin/includes/head.php, sidebar.php, header.php, footer.php all exist
All 7 admin pages (index, alumnos, tutores, asistencias, usuarios, dispositivos, avisos) use require/include for the shared components instead of inline HTML
The sidebar in sidebar.php includes all 7 navigation links including Avisos
Each page sets $pagina_actual before including sidebar.php so the active state highlights correctly
php -l passes on all modified files with no syntax errors
